_comment: Data-driven system definitions for the ROM import wizard. ROMs are copied to Assets/<platformId>/common on the SD card (verified from Analogue developer docs: https://www.analogue.co/developer/docs/directories-and-sd-folder-structure). IMPORTANT: platformId is defined by each individual openFPGA core's platform definition, NOT globally standardised by Analogue. The values below match the most widely used community cores at time of writing; if you use a different core, confirm its platformId and edit this file - no code change required. suggestedCore is informational only; this tool does not download cores (see issue #13).

systems.notes: ROMs go to Assets/gba/common. Some GBA cores can use an optional BIOS; not required and not copied by default.
ROMs go to Assets/genesis/common. The .bin extension is ambiguous (also used by other systems); confirm before bulk-copying a mixed folder.
HuCard ROMs go to Assets/pce/common. CD-based games need additional setup not covered by the MVP.

EXPERIMENTAL: Neo Geo requires a system BIOS and specific romset formats that this tool does not fully manage. It can place files into Assets/ng, but BIOS is only copied if you explicitly request it. Verify your core's exact requirements manually.

ROMs go to Assets/ngpc/common (.ngc; .ngp also accepted for NGP back-compat). The community NGPC core is jotego's Patreon beta (https://www.patreon.com/jotego) - it is not publicly downloadable, so install the zip you obtained via 'Install a core you supply' on the cores step. If your core declares a different platform-id, its own ROM row appears automatically after install.
